## Safety Checklist

- [ ] This branch was created from `origin/main`
- [ ] `./tools/check_git_safety.sh` passes locally
- [ ] No direct push to `main` was used
- [ ] No `--force` push or unrelated-history merge was used
- [ ] Work started from the latest `origin/main` (not a stale local copy; no `project.godot`)
- [ ] Everything is committed and pushed (no work left only on a PC, in `outputs/` or a stash)
- [ ] Generated images/audio are committed under `assets/` or `asset_sources/`
